t: What he said after praying the wrong number
a: إِنَّهُ لَوْ حَدَثَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شَىْءٌ لَنَبَّأْتُكُمْ بِهِ، وَلَكِنْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ، أَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ، فَإِذَا نَسِيتُ فَذَكِّرُونِي
p: Innahu law ḥadatha fi-ṣ-ṣalāti shayʾun la-nabbaʾtukum bih. Wa lākin innamā anā basharun mithlukum, ansā kamā tansawn, fa-idhā nasītu fa-dhakkirūnī
m: If anything had changed in the prayer I would have told you. But I am only a human being like you. I forget as you forget. So when I forget, remind me.
